SIFF announces winning projects of 2026 Courageous Documentary Filmmaking Grants

SIFF announced the winning projects of the third year of its SIFF Grant for Courageous Documentary Filmmaking program, distributing $450,000 in funding to documentary filmmakers across Washington State.

Submissions open for the 53rd annual Seattle International Film Festival, returning May 13-23, 2027

Submissions open for the 53rd annual Seattle International Film Festival, returning May 13-23, 2027. Filmmakers are invited to submit their work now through December 17, 2026.
